reasons.translation-metadata-moved: Web3D's VRML97 converter moves a metadata node out of a node VRML97 gives no metadata field, writing 'closing node early, pushing metadata node afterwards as peer'; the field it then writes at the top level is no VRML97 syntax.
reasons.translation-export-import: The converter writes X3D's EXPORT and IMPORT statements as a block, 'EXPORT { ... }', which no encoding has.
reasons.translation-syntax: The translation does not parse: the converter leaves out a field name before a node (CollidableShape's shape, SpatialSound's children), writes an SFString without quotes (language GLSL), repeats a field for each node of a list (trimmingContour), or the file is cut short.
reasons.not-vrml97: Not VRML97: VRML 1.0, Lattice XVL nodes, or node types of one browser's own (NurbsSurface, CoordinateDeformer, KbdSensor, Torus, PolygonBackground).
reasons.content-faults: The scene's own content is wrong: a ROUTE, USE or IS naming a node or field it does not have, or one of another type or access; a field given more nodes than it holds; a Script declaring a field its node type has; a value its field type cannot take.
reasons.translation-unreadable: The translation into this encoding does not read (a syntax error from one of the faults above), so nothing of it compares with the .x3d.
reasons.translation-metadata-doubled: The ClassicVRML converter writes a nested MetadataSet's children twice.
reasons.translation-differs: The translation says something other than the .x3d beside it: a field dropped (WorldInfo info and title, farDistance, HAnimHumanoid version), an IS connection commented out, an empty string dropped from an MFString, whitespace changed in a Script's source, a declaration's type changed (MFDouble to MFFloat), a header's version or profile changed, or a different revision of the scene.
reasons.binary-attribute-names: The .x3db does not decode to the scene beside it: its attributes come out with other names and values. vrml.x3d.fivocabulary numbers attribute names past 53 by inference, since no edition of table A.3 publishes the files' numbering; a published numbering would settle it.
reasons.schema-file-values: Written as 4.1, the scene carries a value of its own that the 4.1 schema refuses: an enumeration value or component of another version or browser, a number out of range, a required attribute it lacks, a DEF it repeats, or a node where the schema allows none.
reasons.version-upgrade-conflict: Written as 4.1, a 3.x Script's declaration takes the name of a field 4.x gives Script (description), with another type or access.
reasons.schema-content-model: The 4.1 schema's content model refuses a node the field allows: PointSet's normal.
reasons.self-declared-invalid: The scene says in its meta 'error' that it is not valid: a Transform both connected by IS and given children.
